profile.name: Keithley 2400/2182 I-V测量系统
profile.description: 由Keithley 2400源表与2182纳伏表组成的精密电学测量系统，用于向样品施加电流并测量微弱电压信号，常用于I-V扫描、电阻表征和低噪声电输运实验。
profile.description_en: A precision electrical measurement system combining a Keithley 2400 SourceMeter and a 2182 nanovoltmeter. It is used to source current into a sample and measure very small voltage signals for I-V sweeps, resistance characterization, and low-noise transport experiments.

registry.name: I-V Combined Measurement
